name: intentos
description: Verification and coordination for Codex coding agents: index a repository into a world model with approved business rules, compile each ticket into a contract, implement in an isolated worktree with coordination hooks, verify independently with hidden tests, and merge through a gate that re-verifies against the main of right now.

interface.shortDescription: Does the code belong, and is it safe to merge?
interface.longDescription: IntentOS wraps Codex with an engineering world model and an independent verifier. Onboard a repository, mine its business rules with a second model, and every ticket becomes a compiled change contract, an isolated implementation with coordination hooks, and a verification against hidden acceptance tests and invariants. Merges go through a gate with a review tier, head-bound approvals and a merged-result verification; a guardian bisects a red main to the culprit merge and opens a validated undo PR. Tools: status, onboard, mine, explain, policy, run, runs, merge, guard.
